description: Refactor legacy callback-style API calls to Promise-based calls using regex find-and-replace. Target workspace at /home/ga/workspace/legacy-api-project contains JavaScript files with old pattern: 'apiClient.fetchUser(userId, function(error, user) { if (error) { console.error(error); } else { console.log(user); } });'. Convert to new Promise pattern: 'apiClient.fetchUser(userId).then(user => { console.log(user); }).catch(error => { console.error(error); });'. Use Find in Files (Ctrl+Shift+F) with regex enabled to search for the callback pattern across all .js files. Must successfully refactor at least 3 target files: src/user-service.js, src/profile-manager.js, and src/auth-handler.js. Replace old callback-style with Promise-based .then() and .catch() blocks while preserving error handling logic. Save all modified files using Ctrl+K S or File > Save All.
